metadata.description: Complete DCI events archive from Wayback Machine (2013-2024)

dataQualityNotes.complete: Events with start time, venue address, AND performance lineup schedule
dataQualityNotes.partial: Events with at least one of: start time, venue address, or lineup
dataQualityNotes.minimal: Events with basic info only (name, date, location city/state)
dataQualityNotes.note: Time and address data was only available in older API versions (2019-2021). Newer seasons only have competition/scoring data from /competitions endpoint.

events.name: DCI Celebration - Austin
events.notesIndividualTickets:
Ticket prices range from $30 - $25.
Ticket prices increase $5 on the day of the event.
Sale prices do not include $5.95 non-refundable processing fee per ticket.

Day of Show Tickets: All ticket sales will occur online – there will be no cash transactions available at the box office. There is limited seating available for this event, so be sure to order your tickets in advance of coming to the stadium. Box office staff will be on site to assist with any issues accessing your tickets.
events.notesGroupTickets:
Scholastic Groups of 20 or more receive a $5 discount in any section.
Sale prices do not include $2.95 non-refundable processing fee per ticket.

Day of Show Tickets: All ticket sales will occur online – there will be no cash transactions available at the box office. There is limited seating available for this event, so be sure to order your tickets in advance of coming to the stadium. Box office staff will be on site to assist with any issues accessing your tickets.
events.notesGeneral:
DCI Celebration - Austin is presented by FJM, Inc.

An important 2021 safety reminder from Drum Corps International

Spectator Parking - On site parking available at $5 for general parking.

Clear Bag - In an effort to improve safety and security, Round Rock ISD has a Clear Bag Policy at all large scale events held at the Kelly Reeves Athletic Complex. For more information please visit athletics.roundrockisd.org/clear-bag-policy/.
